## ⚔️ LAST KINGDOM — 2D Tower Defense

Defend the kingdom from incoming enemy waves in this complete 2D tower defense game.

### Features

- **Four tower types** — 🏹 Archer, 🛡️ Spear Guard, 🔥 Flame Acolyte, 🎯 Ballista, each with its own placement cost, damage, range, fire rate and attack animation.
- **Multiple enemy types** — Militia, Spearman, Knight, Brute and the terrifying **Boss** enemies (with enrage phase).
- **Tower upgrades** — Between waves the Royal Treasury offers upgrade decrees that strengthen placed towers (+50% damage, +15% range, +35% fire rate).
- **Enemy wave progression** — 12 escalating waves across 3 challenging maps, with boss waves at the end of every third act.
- **Gold & resource management** — Earn gold from kills, spend it on towers, upgrades and continue to the next wave.
- **Different attack animations** — Archer draw & release, Spear Guard swing, Acolyte fire cast, Ballista reload.
- **Boss enemies** — Massive bosses with enlarged sprites, HP bars, crowns and a rage phase.
- **Three challenging maps** — The Fords, The Old Forest, The Black Citadel.
- **Health & wave indicators** — Kingdom hearts, wave counter, enemies remaining and gold HUD.
- **Mobile-friendly placement** — Tap a tower, then tap the field to place it; touch-ready controls.
- **Victory & defeat screens** — Campaign stats and restart options.

### Play

Open `index.html` in a browser, or serve the folder statically:

```bash
python3 -m http.server 8000
```

Then open http://localhost:8000 and press **⚔ BEGIN THE CAMPAIGN**.

## ⚔️ LAST KINGDOM — 2D Tower Defense

Defend the kingdom from incoming enemy waves in this complete 2D tower defense game.

### Features

- **Four tower types** — 🏹 Archer, 🛡️ Spear Guard, 🔥 Flame Acolyte, 🎯 Ballista, each with its own placement cost, damage, range, fire rate and attack animation.
- **Multiple enemy types** — Militia, Spearman, Knight, Brute and the terrifying **Boss** enemies (with enrage phase).
- **Tower upgrades** — Between waves the Royal Treasury offers upgrade decrees that strengthen placed towers (+50% damage, +15% range, +35% fire rate).
- **Enemy wave progression** — 12 escalating waves across 3 challenging maps, with boss waves at the end of every third act.
- **Gold & resource management** — Earn gold from kills, spend it on towers, upgrades and continue to the next wave.
- **Different attack animations** — Archer draw & release, Spear Guard swing, Acolyte fire cast, Ballista reload.
- **Boss enemies** — Massive bosses with enlarged sprites, HP bars, crowns and a rage phase.
- **Three challenging maps** — The Fords, The Old Forest, The Black Citadel.
- **Health & wave indicators** — Kingdom hearts, wave counter, enemies remaining and gold HUD.
- **Mobile-friendly placement** — Tap a tower, then tap the field to place it; touch-ready controls.
- **Victory & defeat screens** — Campaign stats and restart options.

### Play

Open `index.html` in a browser, or serve the folder statically:

```bash
python3 -m http.server 8000
```

Then open http://localhost:8000 and press **⚔ BEGIN THE CAMPAIGN**.

## ⚔️ LAST KINGDOM — Complete 2D Tower Defense Game

### Files created (in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/`)
| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `index.html` | Game shell: canvas, menu / treasury / victory / defeat overlays, tower placement bar |
| `css/style.css` | Dark fantasy theme, responsive layout, mobile-friendly touch controls |
| `js/data.js` | World config, 3 maps, 5 enemy types, 4 tower types, upgrade tables |
| `js/engine.js` | Math helpers + waypoint-based enemy pathfinding |
| `js/game.js` | Game state, waves, combat, rendering (~1000 lines) |

### Feature coverage
- **Four tower types** — 🏹 Archer, 🛡️ Spear Guard, 🔥 Flame Acolyte, 🎯 Ballista — each with distinct damage, range, fire rate, projectile type and animation (bow draw/release, spear swing, fire cast, ballista reload).
- **Multiple enemy types** — Militia, Spearman, Knight, Brute + **Bosses** (The Last King at waves 5/10/12) with enlarged sprites, crowns, HP bars and rage phase.
- **Tower upgrades** — Royal Treasury between waves offers +50% damage / +15% range / +35% fire-rate decrees that upgrade all placed towers of a type.
- **Wave progression** — 12 escalating waves with boss encounters; escalating enemy HP/speed/difficulty.
- **Gold management** — Start with 150 gold; kill rewards, tower costs, upgrade costs, "not enough gold" feedback.
- **Real gameplay systems** — Nearest-enemy targeting within range, projectile travel + hit detection, melee windup damage, waypoint pathfinding, base breach damage.
- **Three maps** — The Fords, The Old Forest, The Black Citadel.
- **Health/wave indicators** — Kingdom hearts, `WAVE x / 12`, enemies remaining, gold HUD.
- **Mobile-friendly** — Tap tower → tap field to place, touch-action handling, responsive portrait layout.
- **Victory/defeat screens** — Campaign stats (waves, kills, gold, time), play again / change map.

### Verification performed (via headless Chromium + Playwright)
- ✅ Menu → campaign start → wave spawning/pathing/breach damage
- ✅ Tower placement (gold deduction, collision-free field)
- ✅ Archer combat loop: windup → projectile → damage applied
- ✅ Wave clear → treasury → upgrade purchase → level-up → continue → next wave
- ✅ Defeat screen on base destruction, Victory screen on final wave clear, restart flow

Two real bugs were found and fixed during browser testing (missing CSS `hidden` class, and the continue-button label destroying its inner `<span id="treasury-next">` mid-game, which crashed the wave-clear handler). The final build passes syntax checks and runs cleanly.
